label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform, Identity, Rewards and Support, plus Conversational AI, Uvation Pulse, Atlas CRM, Devops and Design Marketing Development Collab
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: On the 15 Oct release date the journey review (MT-1586) closed with all 13 reviews done, including Request for Quote (MT-1588) and Order Checkout (MT-1590). RMA automated tests (MT-1569) and three RMA bugs closed, and payment callbacks (MT-1544), brand data in the product query (MT-1564) and three more RMA fixes reached Ready for Prod, bringing 33 Marketplace items to Ready for Prod; none has moved to Done yet, and smoke testing (MT-1541) is still in Dev Test. The October 2nd Sprint was planned with 37 new items: a Magento upgrade to 2.4.9 (MT-1615), GDPR and SOC-2 compliance (MT-1616), chatbot integration (MT-1626) and Playwright test automation (MT-1632). 20 items are past due.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: Marketing released to production on 15 Oct: all 116 Ready for Prod items moved to Done, including the live chat widget (MR-754), the Figma fixes (MR-1179), the sitemap fix (MR-1199), the changes from Raluca Conea's feedback (MR-1341) and the chatbot QA and defects (MR-1309, MR-1311, MR-1312, MR-1327, MR-1337). 122 Marketing items closed that day and open bugs fell from 19 to 1. The two rewards bugs Kannan Elangovan raised on 14 Oct (MR-1359, MR-1360) are no longer visible in Jira. New: Sonar clean-up of the CMS API (MR-1073 and six subtasks), Microsoft Bookings to replace Calendly (MR-1362) and H1 tags on 18 pages (MR-1361, which repeats DM-1091). 8 items are past due.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: The IAM and role-security story (USP-4234, Cășvan Marcel) and its nine subtasks, due 2 Oct, moved to Deployed in Dev on 15 Oct. Livian Stefan Stan closed two dashboard stories (USP-4341, USP-4342), deployed the dashboard clean-up (USP-4337) to Dev and raised a Highest security bug: Switch Access seat claims in the B2C token are not bound to the signed-in person (USP-4369). The Oct 1st Sprint ends on 15 Oct and the Oct 2nd Sprint starts on 16 Oct. Two S1 bugs remain open (USP-4231, USP-4204); 100 items are past due.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: The 15 Oct milestone closed on its due date: the Teams handoff (UC-22), admin analytics (UC-25), model selection (UC-26) and Marketplace sign-in for the chatbot (UC-225 and its four subtasks) moved to Done, with the five chatbot bugs (UC-230 to UC-234). Later that day 191 backlog stories and subtasks were updated together, 153 of them assigned to Shivam Dhoundiyal, with due dates from 2 Aug 2026 to 27 Jun 2027; this batch is most of the day's rise in tickets moved. 26 items are past due.

programmes.name: Uvation Pulse
programmes.headline: Sarath Chandra closed the production endpoint and telemetry checks (PULSE-330) and the status page fixes (PULSE-331) on 15 Oct; the per-app and per-platform monitoring dashboards (PULSE-332) are in progress. Anshul Bhargava's Interactive AI Factory tasks sit on the PRD board, outside this report's boards.

programmes.name: Atlas CRM
programmes.headline: No status change on 15 Oct. Saurabh Jain is building the AI Factory CRM with Gemini and Gmail lead integration (ATLAS-7), and Gourav Agnani's validation of 33 CRM email role plays (ATLAS-8) is in progress. The parent CRM MVP item (ATLAS-1) is still To Do with no due date.

programmes.name: Web-Identity
programmes.headline: The company-details bug (ID-733, Highest) reached Ready for Prod on 15 Oct. Account deactivation and GDPR deletion (ID-747, Yash Janeshwar) moved to Dev Testing: four of its subtasks reached UAT and four more are in Dev Testing. Cross-browser sign-up and SSO testing (ID-757) closed. The identity remediation task (ID-736) and the Klaviyo notifications bug (ID-758) were re-dated from 15 Oct to 30 Oct. 6 items are past due.

programmes.name: Web-Rewards
programmes.headline: No change on 15 Oct. The 18 regression-test items raised on 30 Sep are all To Do, unassigned and undated; one older bug (REW-156) is in UAT.

programmes.name: Web-Support
programmes.headline: No Web-Support ticket was created or updated in the last 30 days.

programmes.name: Devops
programmes.headline: The production AKS resize (IN-1126 and four subtasks), the AKS build-agent research (IN-1128, IN-1144) and four DevOps request subtasks (IN-1137 to IN-1140) closed on 15 Oct, and b.kumar deployed Qdrant, the Chat AI agent and CSM support to production (IN-1155). 15 items still sit in BLOCKER status, most held by k.kishore, and 21 are past due; the S1 login error-page bug (IN-1111) is still To Do.

programmes.name: Design Marketing Development Collab
programmes.headline: The portal HTTP-to-HTTPS fix (DM-1090) and the marketing site 404 work (DM-1082) moved to review on 15 Oct, and the inactive Klaviyo API key was deleted (DM-1092). New: the homepage redirect chain (DM-1093) and two questions from Murali G on the Marketplace abandoned-cart flow in Klaviyo and the events page (DM-1094, DM-1095). 27 items are past due.
